# SportingSmiles

> > Custom-fit dental products including sports mouth guards, retainers, night guards, and whitening trays delivered through at-home impression kits.

SportingSmiles specializes in affordable, custom dental solutions for athletes and dental care needs. The company uses patented impression kit technology to create personalized products without requiring in-person dental visits, serving customers across the USA with products like Essix Plus retainers and their best-selling Flexible Super Hard night guards.
